parts.label: a
parts.description: Vertical and horizontal asymptotes of f(x) = 3/(x+2) - 1
parts.tolerance: A1 for x = -2, A1 for y = -1.
parts.notes: A1 for the vertical asymptote x = -2. A1 for the horizontal asymptote y = -1 (A1A1).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Describe the transformations mapping y = 1/x onto f(x) = 3/(x+2) - 1

expected.answer: vertical stretch scale factor 3; translation 2 units left; translation 1 unit down

parts.tolerance: Accept the two translations combined as a translation by the vector (-2, -1) (A1A1). Stretch and translations may be described in either order.
parts.notes: A1 vertical stretch scale factor 3. A1 horizontal translation 2 left. A1 vertical translation 1 down.

parts.label: d
parts.notes: M1 for setting f(x) = 0 and reaching x + 2 = 3. A1 for x = 1.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Vertical and horizontal asymptotes of g(x) = (3x-2)/(x+1)
parts.tolerance: A1 for x = -1, A1 for y = 3.
parts.notes: A1 for x = -1. A1 for y = 3 (ratio of leading coefficients) (A1A1).

parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Accept x = 2/3 and y = -2, or the ordered-pair forms (A1A1).
parts.notes: A1 for x-intercept (2/3, 0). A1 for y-intercept (0, -2).

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for swapping x and y. A1 for correct rearrangement to y(x-3) = -(x+2). A1 for g^{-1}(x) = -(x+2)/(x-3).

parts.label: d
parts.follow_through: Award A1 for x != (the candidate's horizontal-asymptote value of g from part (a)).
